title: INC-1415: Ledger Core incident report
body:
## Impact

The Ledger Core incident described here is closed at the
time of writing. Network Operations linked roughly 12
tickets to the event and engaged Brightpath Security, the
hosting provider, within the first hour.

## Timeline

Events noted by Yuki Tanaka up to 27 October 2025, in order:
- The previous configuration was redeployed to the whole
  pool
- Customers were notified through the public status page
- Failover to the standby database instance was started

## Status

Network Operations lists the incident as closed. Kenji Sato
wrote this report on 20 February 2025 and will review it in
the 03:30-05:00 UTC window before the weekly service
meeting.
